Codex review: this still needs some work.

**Summary**
Keep open: merged onboarding work addresses the reported failure paths, but the exact managed WSL setup-to-Chat scenario remains unverified, and a collaborator-authored closing PR is still open.

Reproducibility: The report supplies two concrete historical reproductions, but current main contains substantial repairs and was not exercised on Windows; this read-only review ran no builds or tests.

**Root-cause cluster**
Relationship: `canonical`
Canonical: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw-windows-node/issues/1781
Summary: This issue owns the no-window report; its focused candidate was incorporated into broader merged onboarding work, while the earlier stuck-window report remains distinct.

Members:
- `fixed_by_candidate`: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw-windows-node/pull/1789 - Explicit closing PR addresses WSL route restart and recovery ordering but remains open.
- `fixed_by_candidate`: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw-windows-node/pull/1626 - Merged integration carries the recovery repair and adds progress and failure presentation; exact managed GPU handoff proof remains outstanding.
- `adjacent_distinct`: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw-windows-node/issues/1780 - Its visible-but-stuck Chat symptom was withdrawn after attempts reproduced this issue's different no-window failure.

Proposal only: this assessment does not dispatch repair, suppress jobs, mutate sibling items, close, or merge anything.

**Next step**
Verify current-main WSL Local AI setup through restart, automatic Chat and first reply, including visible Retry or Fix recovery, then reconcile the overlapping open https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw-windows-node/pull/1789 (fix(setup): open chat after WSL Local AI restart).


<details>
<summary>Review details</summary>

Best possible solution:

Complete setup into usable Chat automatically, with prompt visible progress and an actionable Retry or Fix path when recovery fails.

Do we have a high-confidence way to reproduce the issue?

The report supplies two concrete historical reproductions, but current main contains substantial repairs and was not exercised on Windows; this read-only review ran no builds or tests.

Is this the best way to solve the issue?

The merged changes repair the existing lifecycle and presentation owners, so validate their exact WSL handoff before proposing another implementation or weakening provenance checks.

AGENTS.md: found and applied where relevant.

Remaining risk / open question:

- Current-main managed WSL Local AI setup, restart, automatic Chat opening, and first reply have not been demonstrated together.
- The original InvalidOperationException remains unlocalized; its provenance-check explanation was a reporter hypothesis rather than a confirmed cause.

Codex review notes: model internal, reasoning medium; reviewed against [7967d509886f](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw-windows-node/commit/7967d509886fc9efecbb19c8236350a82867f69c).

</details>

</details>

<details>
<summary>Evidence reviewed</summary>

What I checked:

- **Current default branch verified:** GitHub main and the clean checkout both resolve to 7967d509886fc9efecbb19c8236350a82867f69c. ([7967d509886f](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw-windows-node/commit/7967d509886fc9efecbb19c8236350a82867f69c))
- **Open closing PR preserves the issue:** https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw-windows-node/pull/1789 (fix(setup): open chat after WSL Local AI restart) remains open and draft, explicitly closes this issue, and is by the same collaborator.
- **The proposed recovery changes reached main through broader work:** https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw-windows-node/pull/1626 (fix(onboarding): finish setup before showing AI as ready) merged on October 26 and includes the WSL publication restart and recovery-before-verification changes; its final body explicitly leaves product-managed NVIDIA Local AI recovery, Ready latency, and inference unverified. ([`src/OpenClaw.Tray.WinUI/Services/LocalAiGatewayProviderCoordinator.cs:219`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw-windows-node/blob/d318127350b5a42586a654ddd3657c28a73c27f9/src/OpenClaw.Tray.WinUI/Services/LocalAiGatewayProviderCoordinator.cs#L219), [d318127350b5](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw-windows-node/commit/d318127350b5a42586a654ddd3657c28a73c27f9))
- **Current verification waits for WSL recovery:** Preparation now waits before borrowing the WSL connection, and destination verification also invokes model recovery before opening a temporary session; the verifier blob is identical to the merged onboarding version. ([`src/OpenClaw.SetupEngine/SetupNativeCompletionVerifier.cs:54`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw-windows-node/blob/7967d509886fc9efecbb19c8236350a82867f69c/src/OpenClaw.SetupEngine/SetupNativeCompletionVerifier.cs#L54), [7967d509886f](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw-windows-node/commit/7967d509886fc9efecbb19c8236350a82867f69c))
- **Visible presentation and recovery exist in current source:** WindowManager activates an early setup progress window and routes handoff failures to the Ready failure surface, persistent notification, Connection window, and conditional Retry dialog. ([`src/OpenClaw.Tray.WinUI/Services/WindowManager.cs:257`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw-windows-node/blob/7967d509886fc9efecbb19c8236350a82867f69c/src/OpenClaw.Tray.WinUI/Services/WindowManager.cs#L257), [7967d509886f](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw-windows-node/commit/7967d509886fc9efecbb19c8236350a82867f69c))
- **Existing regression covers recovery ordering:** PublishedWslReadyWaitsForModelRecoveryBeforeBorrowingGateway holds recovery pending and checks that verification does not borrow prematurely; NativeCompletionPresentationTests checks early window ordering and failure-dialog lifecycle through source assertions. ([`tests/OpenClaw.SetupEngine.Tests/SetupGatewaySessionBindingTests.cs:79`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw-windows-node/blob/7967d509886fc9efecbb19c8236350a82867f69c/tests/OpenClaw.SetupEngine.Tests/SetupGatewaySessionBindingTests.cs#L79), [7967d509886f](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw-windows-node/commit/7967d509886fc9efecbb19c8236350a82867f69c))

</details>

issue.body:
Fixes #1781.

## What changed

After WSL Local AI setup restarts the app-owned Gateway, setup waits for that Gateway and its selected model route before presenting Ready. The wait stays bound to the owning Gateway, has a deadline, and preserves the restart receipt across retry. Existing setup and tray tests cover these cases.

This branch contains source and changes to existing tests only. Screenshots are hosted on a separate proof branch.

## Required proof pools

- `windows-11-arm64`: rebased-head build and app launch passed on RTXspark2.
- `windows-wsl-dgx-blackwell`: the existing 21.4 GB Local AI model answered a prompt on the rebased head.
- `windows-wsl-gateway-e2e`: rebased-head app connected to the existing WSL Gateway and received a Chat reply. Fresh WSL setup and Ready were captured on the pre-rebase head.
- `windows-winui-interactive`: rebased-head Connected Chat and reply captured; broader accessibility gallery remains open.
- `windows-wsl-mxc`: strict containment blocked by the missing MXC BaseContainer on RTXspark2.
- `windows-clean-installer-upgrade`: existing-profile source upgrade tested on the pre-rebase head; signed installer upgrade remains open.

## Validation

RTXspark2 isolated Windows worktree at rebased head `518d8b6f29d8a4ea1da7359f6c62d4ab349c9d81` (main base `bef07da01911fa78ed5ab728ab9248bbb1ec0466`):

| Command | Result |
| --- | --- |
| `./build.ps1` | Passed, including WinUI. |
| Shared tests, `--no-restore` | 4,660 passed, 24 skipped. |
| Tray tests, `--no-restore` | 4,472 passed, 4 ARM64 `BuildPrerequisiteTests.CheckOnly_UsesTheAppLocalRuntimeResolver` failures. |
| Tray tests excluding `BuildPrerequisiteTests` | 4,472 passed, 0 failed. |
| SetupEngine tests, `--no-restore` | 2,436 passed, 1 skipped. |
| Connection tests, `--no-restore` | 1,669 passed, 3 migration-checker failures, 1 skipped. The same focused failures reproduced on main on this host. |

The full Tray and Connection suites are not reported as passes. The failing tests do not touch this patch's changed paths. Earlier-head strict MXC E2E returned 11 passed, 7 skipped, exit 1 because the MXC BaseContainer is absent; that is not MXC merge validation. Rubber-duck and code-skeptic reviews found no material source issue on the rebased head.

## Real behavior proof

- Environment: RTXspark2, Windows 11 ARM64, interactive RDP, isolated app profile and WSL Gateway.
- Before: on main `51f18c12`, fresh WSL Gateway and Local AI setup reached Ready, but Talk returned to the AI setup catalog. [Main after Talk](https://github.com/joelagnel/openclaw-windows-node/blob/6c7862fa59bd5f871e8fecdefb8e06e6b54e74e6/pr1789/rtxspark2-249f9285/main-returned-to-ai-setup.png).
- After on pre-rebase head `249f9285`: the same isolated profile verified the existing model, reached [Ready](https://github.com/joelagnel/openclaw-windows-node/blob/6c7862fa59bd5f871e8fecdefb8e06e6b54e74e6/pr1789/rtxspark2-249f9285/ready.png), opened [Connected Chat](https://github.com/joelagnel/openclaw-windows-node/blob/6c7862fa59bd5f871e8fecdefb8e06e6b54e74e6/pr1789/rtxspark2-249f9285/chat-connected.png), and [answered `PR1789-UPGRADE-OK`](https://github.com/joelagnel/openclaw-windows-node/blob/6c7862fa59bd5f871e8fecdefb8e06e6b54e74e6/pr1789/rtxspark2-249f9285/chat-reply.png). Profile settings and device-identity file hashes stayed unchanged across that source upgrade.
- Rebased current head `518d8b6f`: the rebuilt app launched against the existing profile, showed Owner Connected, and a new Chat session [answered `REBASED1789-OK`](https://github.com/joelagnel/openclaw-windows-node/blob/cfd75ad6f1aff8128192b7c1cbcbbe7082a8a80b/pr1789/rtxspark2-518d8b6f/chat-reply.png). The process path and Git head were verified before capture.
- Not verified on the rebased head: fresh WSL installation and the Ready transition. Signed MSIX upgrade, broad accessibility gallery, and strict MXC containment remain open.

## Security and compatibility

No new permission, command surface, endpoint, credential format, or migration. Signed-package migration remains unverified.
